title: Terms of Use for Our Free Calculators | Wattlyst

content.html:
By using Wattlyst you agree to these terms. The calculators and guides are free, provided for general information and planning, and come with no warranty.

Use of the site

  • You may use the calculators and share links to results for personal and business purposes.
  • Do not copy the site's text or tools in bulk, scrape it in a way that harms its performance, or present our results as an official bill or certification.
  • Do not try to break, overload or misuse the site.

No professional advice

The calculators and guides are for general information and education only. Results are estimates and are not electrical, engineering, financial or legal advice. Decisions about purchases, installations, bills and complaints are your own. Read the disclaimer.

Not an official bill or evidence

  • A bill result is an estimate made from published tariffs, taxes and charges. It is not an official bill and not a finding that your bill is right or wrong. The official figures are the bill your DISCO or K-Electric issues and the notifications of NEPRA and the Federal Board of Revenue.
  • Do not present a Wattlyst result, page or download as evidence or proof before a court, NEPRA, the Wafaqi Mohtasib, a consumer court or any other forum. If you do, you do so on your own responsibility.
  • To dispute a bill, complain to your DISCO first, using the complaint number printed on your bill. If it is not resolved, you can file a complaint with NEPRA or the Wafaqi Mohtasib.

Accuracy and changes

We work to keep formulas and data correct and dated, but tariffs, taxes and prices change, and our data may be wrong or out of date. Each rate and price on the site shows its source and the date we last checked it; check them before you rely on a result. We do not guarantee that the site is error-free or always available. We may change, add or remove tools and these terms at any time; the date below shows the latest version.

No affiliation

Wattlyst is an independent site. It is not part of, endorsed by or acting for NEPRA, any DISCO, K-Electric, PITC, the Federal Board of Revenue or any government office. Their names appear only to say whose tariff, bill or data a page uses.

Links to other sites

We link to sources such as NEPRA, DISCOs and manufacturers. We are not responsible for the content of other sites.

Limitation of liability

To the extent allowed by law, Wattlyst and its team are not liable for any loss or damage, or for any decision, payment, complaint or legal action, arising from the use of the site or its results or from relying on them.

Privacy

How we handle data is explained in our privacy policy.

Governing law

Wattlyst is run by Ali Ahmad in Pakistan. These terms are governed by the laws of Pakistan, and the courts of Pakistan decide any dispute about them, unless the law of the country you live in gives you a right that cannot be taken away by agreement.

Contact

Questions about these terms: contact@wattlyst.com.
